diagnosis: The check C7 passed in all four rollouts because the settlement always set 'admin_log_retention_days' to 30, which matches the default value specified in PF3. Since the lone decision-maker never had access to PF3, this default setting allowed the check to pass without requiring the hidden information.

C7.why: The draft's 30-day ordinary logs change under PF3 to exactly 400 days of immutable retention for privileged administrator authentication events.
